explanation: Per the Kazhdan-Lusztig conjecture (proved 1981), the $P_{x,w}(q)$ control multiplicities of simples in Verma modules, plus the topology of Schubert varieties and characters in characteristic $p$. Brauer characters and projective indecomposables belong to modular representation theory; decomposing the regular representation is ordinary character theory, not KL theory.
